tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ni gu chos drug gi 'jug sgo yon tan kun 'byung bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ shangs pa bka' brgyud kyis chos skor rnams kyi 'jug sgo yon tan kun 'byung zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'chang chen ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /khyung po rnal 'byor rin chen brtson 'grus dang / /dar ma seng ge rgyal ba 'od zer dang / /bla chen khams pa chos rje 'dzin pa la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /mkha' mnyam sems can rnams la byin gyis rlobs/ /thabs lam sgyu lus 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam 'od gsal zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /'pho thebs bar do chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dir sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ sa chog dgos par rgyas bsdus gang grub gzhan dang mthun par bya/ gnas khang phyag dar rten 'gram grub na dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom par 'gyur ba dang mthun par gzhi bri/ ma grub na maṇḍal bzhi'i thig gdab/ dang po la chos 'byung nyis brtsegs dkar po'i dbus su me tog tshom pu lnga'am lha lnga'i phyag mtshan nam/ sa bon nam/ thig le bkod/ de'i mu khyud nag po/ rtsibs chen dmar po/ de'i 'og ma la padma 'dab bzhi phyogs mtshon/ gru chad ljang khu/ gsum pa la chos 'byung dmar po/ me ris gzhi ljang khu/ zla gam mthing ljang dkar po/ bzhi pa la mthing nag gru gsum/ me ris gzhi dmar po/ zla gam ljang khu/ de rnams kyi mu 'khyud nag po/ maṇḍal las mi grub na/ mu 'khyud kyi phyi nas rdo rwa me ri bya/ yongs rdzogs grub na thams cad kyi khyams phyogs tshon la sogs dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang mthun par bris/ 'og ma gsum po la'ang tshom bu la sogs lnga lnga bkod/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bcud dang mgul chings kha rgyan rdo rje gzungs thag dung chos rnams gzhan dang mthun par maṇḍal gnyis pa'i steng du bzhag bzhi pa'i steng du gtor ma gtsang zhing bzang ba mda' dar dang bcas pa bzhag

ci 'byor ba'i mchod gtor dang / tshogs kyi yo byad bshams/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis btang / mchod pa byin dbab/ las kyi rdo rjes spyir maṇḍal dang / so so la me tog phul la gsol ba btab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams ci 'grub bya/ rang bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs bla ma gtso bo'i rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spyan drangs/ phyag 'tshal mchod pa dbul/ rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ shu n+yā ta dang / swa bhā was stong par sgom pa'i ngang las srung 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i bdag bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs su/ mdun skyed maṇḍal dang bsgrub pa'i skabs bzhin bsgom/ chos skor 'di yi lugs kyi rdzogs rim gang mos bsgom/ lha rang rang gi thugs khar pad nyi'i steng du/ sa bon hūm̐ gi mtha' mar rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor bar bsgom/ oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadzra ṭig hūm̐ swā hāḥ oṃ āḥhri hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ oṃ hṛṣṭi wi kri ta na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams so sor ci nus su bzlas so/ /de nas phyi mchod rnams sumbha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ a las thod par 'bru gsum las lha mi'i mchod rdzas dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar bskyed/ rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ maṇḍal bum pa rnams kyang rim bzhin bsangs sbyangs pa'i ngang las thams cad kyang / ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa lnga phyi nas rim pas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba/ 'dod yon dmar/ pha gu ser/ drwa phyed sngo/ /mda' yab sna tshogs sgo'i thad sor rta bab bang rim bzhi pa la/ padma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang / ri dwags gnyis gnyis dang bcas pa'i steng na gdugs phub pa/

nang ka ba brgyad brgyad kyi stegs cing / rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu'i tog gi mtshan pa/ mchod rten mgo lnga pa'i rnam pa/ phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad dang / rdo rje rwa ba me ris bskor ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od kyi rang bzhin/ nang gi lha snam rnams/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i pho brang dang po'i dbus su/ shel las grub pa'i chos 'byung gnyis rim gyi lte ba'i dbus su rin po che'i khri/ seng ge brgyad kyi stegs pa dang / sna tshogs padma zla nyi'i steng na/ 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan pa'i bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum la 'khyud cing g.yas brkyang pas bzhengs pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khril ba/ de'i shar du gdan bzhi rtseg gi steng na tshangs pa brgya byin mnan pa'i dges rdor mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum bdag med ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ lho phyogs su gdan bzhi rtseg gi steng du gsang 'dus sku mdog mthing shun lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum reg bya rdo rje ma sku mdog phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra ba la 'khyud cing / gnyis ka'ang skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ nub tu gdan bzhi'i rtseg dang / mi ro'i steng na ma hā ma ya mthing nag g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum zhal gcig phyag gnyis khā ṭwāṃ ka dang thod khrag 'dzin pas/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sku mdog phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra ba la 'khyud pa/ byang du gdan bzhi rtseg dang ma he'i steng du rdo rje 'jigs byed nag po ma he'i zhal can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pas/ yum ro lang ma dmar mo gri thod can la 'khyud pa/

rwa rno ba/ shangs 'bud cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ sku lus thung sbom gsus khyim che ba/ sbrul gyis lhag par brgyan pa/ maṇḍal gnyis pa'i bum pa gzhal yas khang du bsgom pa'i nang du yang lha lnga gong bzhin bskyed/ maṇḍal gsum pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi rten yin te/ de'i dbus su bde mchog lhan skyes dang / de'i phyogs bzhir/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro he dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin zhing / gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ka g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de ltar yab yum thams cad mtshan dpes brgyan cing / 'od zer 'bar ba/ me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhal re re spyan gsum pa/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yab thams cad rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ dbu skra dang sma ra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ yum thams cad sgeg cing 'dzum pa/ bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ dbu skra sil bur 'phyang ba/ maṇḍal gsum po'i gru chad rnams la mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa/ khyams rnams su phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad longs sku zhal sbyor/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin til gyi gang bu kha phye ba lta bur bsgom/ maṇḍal bzhi pa'i dbus su/ dpal ldan phyag drug pa lha lnga gtor chog ltar bskyed/ de'i khyams su phyogs skyong bcu/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bsam/ de rnams thams cad skad cig dran rdzogs bsam/ snying po tshig tsam mam/ rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed/ thams cad kyi gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed rnams kyis thugs kha'i sa bon las/

'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ye shes par spyan drangs la sngags tsam gyis mchod/ dzāḥhūm̐ baṃ hos dam tshig pa rnams la bstim/ yang 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs la mchod de/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ gis gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ra sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ zhes pas dbang bskur/ thams cad la mi bskyod pa sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa can gyi dbu brgyan par bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇḍal sa pā ri wa ra sngon du 'gro bas/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnga rol mo gos gzung rnams rang rang gi sngags kyis thun mong du dbul/ spro na tshigs bcad kyang bya/ nang mchod kyang bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan dang / yi dam rnams kyi so so'i sngags la 'bru gsum btags la dbul/ chos skyong la sogs la'ang gzhan dang mthun par dbul zhing / ci shes pas bstod la/ bum bzlas byas te/ slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ skyor chu blugs/ bdag 'jug bya/ gtor ma rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ lha lnga gang rung gi cho ga gzhan dang mthun par bya/ so so'i rang sngags sam/ gong gi mchod sngags la ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags la dbul/ mchod bstod rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis brjod/ mgon po la gtor chog ltar phul 'phrin las gzhol/ spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag la'ang phul/ bgegs gtor gtang ngo / /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ dang po sngon 'gro 'jug pa ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇḍal 'jug yon phul nas 'khod pa la/ 'di skad brjod de/ klu sgrub kyis/ rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing bu gar ni/ /rus sbal chud pa bas kyang dud 'gro bas/ /mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gi /dam chos spyod pas 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ mi lus rnyed dka' bar gsungs la/

rnyed pa'i tshe ma 'bad na/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'di las thar pa'i skabs med pas chos la 'jug dgos/ de la theg chung nyan rang rang zhi bde tsam thob par 'dod cing / lta bas bdag dang / chos kyi phyogs gcig gzung ba rang bzhin med pa tsam las ma rtogs pa'i lam de theg chen la bltos nas lam dman pa yin te/ slob spring las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang du chud gyur cing / /klong gi nang du lhung ba lta bu gnang bzhin du/ /skye shi phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /rang nyid gcig thar byed na khrel bor gzhan ci yod/ /ces gsungs pa dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ de gnyis yang dang yang du ni/ /rang sems kun tu 'byung ldan pas/ /mya ngan 'das la mngon dga'i phyir/ /rtogs pa bul ba yin par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pas na gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod cing / lta bas bdag mtha' dag rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i theg chen la 'jug dgos/ de la gnyis yod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa bas sngags kyi theg pa/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas phyir/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pas de la 'jug pa yin te/ de'ang rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes bya ba'i bla med la 'jug pa yin pas/ de'i thog mar dbang thob dgos te/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'phreng ba'i rgyud las/ thog mar slob ma gang gi tshe/ /blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /de yi tshe na snod du 'gyur/ /yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na/ /sgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang / /slob dpon slob ma mtshungs par ni/ /mi zad dmyal ba chen por 'gro/ /zhes dang / phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/

dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de nas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma las ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes dang / mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas la/ /dbang bskur med par sngags 'chad dang / /zab mo'i de nyid sgom byed pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang / /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba min/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas thod pa las/ dper na pi wang sbyor tshogs kun/ /rgyud dang bral na brdungs mi nus/ /de bzhin dbang bskur med pa la/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces dang / thob na de las ldog pa'i phan yon 'byung ste/ thun sang las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de nas skye ba bdun nas de/ /ma sgom pa yang dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /dbang gi sngon du dkyil 'khor dgos shing / de la'ang gsum du gsung ste/ rdo rje dril bu pas/ dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gsungs pa ste/ /zhes dang / ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ dbang bskur dbang po'i bye brag gis/ /ting 'dzin me tog rdul mtshon no/ /zhes dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor slob ma rab 'bring mtha'/ /ting 'dzin me tog rdul mtshon rim/ /zhes gsungs pas/ da lam dkyil 'khor gsum ka ru rim pas 'jug cing dbang bskur ba yin/ de'i sngon 'gro 'jug pa la bcu gsum yod pa'i/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku stong pa nyid dang / snying rje dbyer med pa/ chos zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa/ dge 'dun dag pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/ rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med pa bla ma la blos phul la/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog zhi ba don dam mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa la gnyis las/ dang po smon pa ni/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis sngar ltar mchod la/ brjod par 'gyur pa'i don sems shing / phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin can dang / tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin can dang / sgom pa'i rang bzhin can gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / sa chen po la rab du bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ji ltar thugs bskyed pa bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung nas snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ byang chub kyi mchog du sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa sems bskyed blang ba'i bsam pas brjod pa'i don sems shing / sngar bzhin dgongs gsol gyi rjes su/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/

sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa la mthar gyis bslab pa dang / mthar gyis sbyangs pa dang / mthar gyi nan tan gyis bsam pa brtan po bskyed par bgyi'o/ /phar phyin gzhan lnga yang so so'i ming stabs su brjod nas/ bslab sbyangs nan tan gyi bsam pa sngar bzhin brjod de/ de ltar lan gsum brjod do/ /spyi don gsum pa gsol ba btab pa ni/ sngar phul ba'i maṇḍal yon du dmigs nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni zhugs su gsol/ /zhes lan gsum bya'o/ /bzhi pa gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /khyed ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /de dag gis kyang gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga zab mo 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin du mi zad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang des bcom ste/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de nas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod do/ /lnga pa rtog pa bsdu ba ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs dang / /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi byin mi rlob/ /ces pas so/ /drug pa rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro bas gsang sngags su sems bskyed pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchis/

/sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum bgyi'o/ /bdun pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung nas/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bya/ /nam du yang ni mi spong ngo / /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa de nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs can dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/

/mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces lan gsum gyis bya'o/ /brgyad pa sngags kyi che ba brjod pas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gi spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /duḥkha thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis spyod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyis/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /legs pa nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal pa chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don yang ci rigs su brjod nas/ dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar/ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐ gi gdong bcing ngo / /dgu pa bde stong du sems bskyed pa ni/

slob ma'i snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo dang / de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bor mos su bcug nas/ de brtan pa'i don du dpon slob gnyis kas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta ud pā ta yā mi/ zhes dang / slob dpon gyi slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje reg cing / oṃ su ra te sa ma ya staṃ ho siddhi badzra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams can dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /hūm̐ dza hūm̐ zhes pa ste gsang bar gdams pa'o/ /bcu pa nang du gzhug cing ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas rdo rjes khrid par bsams shing / dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas mgo bo 'dud pa re byed du bcug la nang du gzhug 'khod pa la slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje gzung la/ ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyed kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon dang / snying khar gzung la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyis/ /snying la yang dag gzhug par 'gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag du bral te gshegs/ /zhes dang / yang spyi bor gzung la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nyes dmigs dang / bum chu dang /

bdud rtsi bsres la/ khyor ba g.yas par byin la 'thung du gzhug cing / 'di ni khyod kyis dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub thob/ /rdo rje bdud rtsis chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ pañtsa a mri ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ zhes pas gnyis ka dang / yang spyi bor gzung la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyis/ dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /nga la yang brnyas pa ma byos shig byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas te/ dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyis bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag nas/ ye shes dbab par gsol ba gdab pa'i bsam pas/ rjes bzlos byed du gzhug cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ slob ma rnams lus kyi spyod lam phan tshun ma reg par spyi bor thal mo sbyar la tsog pur 'dug bla ma la rdo rje 'chang dngos kyi 'du shes kyis mos gus drag po gyis la/ bdag tu gzung ba thams cad ltos med du mthong / rang he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rkang mthil zhib nas langs par mos pa'i 'og tu/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can/ rgyud gyen la bstan pa'i steng du gnas pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su dzhaiṃ me'i rang bzhin rlung gis bskyod pas me 'bar ba rtsa nang na yar song / sum mdo'i me dang / lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dres/ snying khar lam las sa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rjes mtshan pa bsregs pas/ mgrin par waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor waṃ gis mtshan pa bskol/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bus thur du mnan pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rgyud sde lnga'i tshogs kyi rnam pas thim par sgom du gzhug

slob dpon gyis/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra a pe sha ya ā a/ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzras brtan par bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa me tog dor cing mgo la bcings pa ni/ lha thams cad dag pa ye shes gcig gi snang ba yin pas bzang ngan med kyang / las bsags pa'i lha la babs par gyur cig snyam pas/ oṃ pra titstsha badzra ho/ zhes pas me tog dor nas gang la phog pa'i lha'i snying po sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ pra ti grihna swa mi maṃ/ satwa mahā bā la oṃ/ zhes pas spyi bor sbyin no/ /bcu gnyis pa gdong g.yogs phye la dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badzra nai tra a wa ha ra pa tra laṃ hṛ praṃ/ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bsal/ dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bskyed pa'i skabs bzhin bstan par bya'o/ /deng dpal ldan 'bras spung gi mchod rten rgyu rin chen las grub pa phyi mchod rten gyi rnam pa/ nang gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa/ rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs kyi rnam pa 'di lta bur yod la de'ang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi ngo bo yin te/ dpal dus 'byung gi rgyud las/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sku ni kye'i rdo rje la/ /gsung ni sgyu 'phrul rdo rje la/ /thugs ni 'khor lo sdom pa che/ /'phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ /bdag nyid gsang ba 'dus par brjod/ /ma 'ongs sems can dus su ni/ /thabs ni de dag bstan pa yin/ /thabs kyi rim pa 'di dag ni/ /kun gyi thung mong ma yin te/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsdus dbang bskur/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rgyud sde rnam pa gang ltar bstan/ /kla klo'i skad kyis 'di sbas pas/ /thub pa'i zhal them gsang ba 'di/ /snying po kun gyi don gyi rgyud/

/dka' thub spyod byed thung mong yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos las kyang / rdo rje 'chang chen lha'i gtso/ /sku ni dges pa rdo rje la/ /gsung ni sgyu 'phrul chen mo la/ /thugs ni rdo rje gsang ba 'dus/ /yon tan bde chen 'khor lo sdom/ /'phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed de/ /phyogs ni dkyil 'khor nges pa can/ /zhes gsung / de rnams thams cad dkyil 'khor gcig bsgom pas kyang / rgyal ba thams cad bsgom par 'gyur te/ rin chen rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ rgyal ba gcig bsgom sangs rgyas kun gyi ngang / /sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhes ngo sprad do/ /gnyis pa dbang dngos la/ bum pa'i dbang dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gnyis las/ bum pa'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ bsam gyis mi khyab dam chos snod/ /dbang bskur dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ sdom pa rgya mtsho dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ skyob pas dkyil 'khor mngon sum du/ /til gyi gang bu bzhin gang ba'i/ /rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni/ /de nyid la ni dbang bskur bar/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid rig pas bsam/ /zhes pa ltar dpon slob gnyis kas bsam zhing / bum pa spyi bor bzhag hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ zhes pas spyi bor gtor zhing khar yang blud pas/ lus kyi dri ma dag cing bum dbang thob par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ bde mchog bde ba'i myu gu las/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /mkha' mnyam ye shes bdud rtsi ni/ /rdo rje'i lam nas byung nas ni/ /bde ba bskyed phyir rigs kyi yum/ /sras bcas gsang ba'i dbang bskur bya/ /zhes gsung pa ltar bsam la/

bum chu dang mngar gsum sbyar ba slob ma'i kha ru sbyin zhing / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /rdo rje dbang skur chen mo sbyin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghu he ya a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes pas ngag gi dri ma dag gsang dbang thob par bsam mo/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes ni/ sngar sbyin pa'i dbang rdzas btung bas/ snying kha yan chad khengs pas yid kyi dri ma dag cing / gsum pa'i ye shes bde stong skyes par bsgom du bcug la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pradzña dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes brjod/ bum chus lus kyi nang thams cad khengs pas/ dri ma thams cad dag cing dbang bzhi pa thob/ 'dzin rtog thams cad dang bral ba brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam mo/ /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi skyod pa sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan par bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gdams ngag dbang dang rjes su 'brel ba dang / dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dpon slob gnyis kas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ye shes kyi chos skyong srung ma dpag du med pa til gyi gang bu kha phye ba bzhin bsams te/ slob mas maṇḍal lan gsum phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bdag la yang dag par sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ ye shes chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis bdag la yang dag par sgyu lus kyi dbang zhu ba dang lam nyams su len pa la bar chad mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas slob ma'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po bsam/ de las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku'i yon tan bsdus/

slar oṃ la thim pas de zhu ba tshangs bug nas lte bar byon/ thig le dkar po gcig tu gyur/ des gti mug dag chos dbyings ye shes su byin gyis brlabs/ de bzhin du spyi bor ā dmar po/ hūm̐ sngon po/ traṃ ser po/ a ljang khu rnams rim bzhin bsam pa la/ yi ge rang rang dang kha dog 'dra ba'i 'od zer rnams 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gsung dang / thugs dang / yon tan dang / 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs rnams bsdus/ yi ge so so la thim pas/ de zhu nas tshangs bug nas lte bar byon pas/ rang rang gi kha dog can gyi thig ler gyur pas/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / nga rgyal dang / ser sna dang / phrag dog gi dri ma rnams dag so sor rtog pa/ me long lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rnams su gyur nas rang nyid ye shes rang snang gi bde mchog lhan skyes su lam bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba ni/ maṇḍal gsum pa'i steng gi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri seng ges btegs par pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la bla ma bde mchog dang gnyis su med pa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis bskor bar bsgom pa la/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge rtsa thams cad phul/ mos gus bya zhing / bla ma rin po ches bdag la bum pa'i dbang skur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i smin phrag nas 'od zer dkar po byung / rang gi smin phrag tu thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad bsangs dag rang lha skur sngar bas kyang gsal bar bsam/ yang mchod pa phul/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thig le dkar po byung / rang gi lce la thim/ ngag gi dri ma dag lha sku sngar bas kyang gsal ba bsam/ yang mchod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs kha nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga byung / rang gi snying khar thim pas yid kyi dri ma dag

lha skur sngar bas kyang gsal ba bsgom/ de'i ngang las lus khongs glod/ sems spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du ma bcos par lhan gyis bzhag pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o/ /yang dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba la gsum ste/ dang po stong pas gzhi byas rig pa sna tshogs su 'char ba ni/ rang gi rtswa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ spyi gtsug nas gsang gnas su zug pa/ gsal btab pa'i nang du snying gi thad kar ā dkar po bsam la/ de ngag du yang mang du brjod la/ dbu ma bye gsal la mthar stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang la sing gis bzhag go /gnyis pa rtsa lam sbyang / rig pa sna tshogs su 'char ba ni/ rang gi spyi bor haṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar a dmar ljang bsam/ haṃ las 'od zer dkar po gsal sing ba 'phros/ spyi bo'i rtsa mdud rnams grol/ mgrin pa'i a gsos/ de la 'od zer dmar po gsal sing ba byung / mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grol/ snying kha'i hūm̐ gsos/ de las 'od zor sngon po gsal sing ba byung / snying kha'i rtsa mdud rnams grol/ lte ba'i a gsos/ de las 'od zer dmar ljang gsal sing ba byung / lte ba nas rkang mthil yar chad kyi rtsa mdud rnams grol/ bde sing ba la sems gtad pa'i ngang nas lhan skyes su lam gyi bsgom mo/ /gsum pa lus dag pa lha skur bsgom pa ni lhan skyes su gsal ba de'i nor bu'i rtse mor hūm̐ sngon po mgo gyen la bstan pa'i rtse mor thig le dmar po sran ma tsam gcig bsam la hūm̐ gi nus pas nor bu nang du bzlog pa bzhin du byung snying khar slebs/ smad kyi 'dod chags sangs dag par bsam/ dbu ma'i yar rtse spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan gyis rtse la thig le dkar po sran ma tsam bsam pa dbu ma na mar la byung / snying khar slebs pas gti mug dag par bsam/ zhe sdang rang dag yin gsung / de nas yang yang gsal gdab cing /

thig le gnyis po snying khar ra thag bzhin du 'khor ba la dmigs pa bum dbang / gcig la gcig reg pas bde sing sing ba la gtad pa gsang dbang / phan tshun 'dres pas bde sing sing ba dbang gsum pa gcig la gcig thim nas mthar 'od du yal nas stong nyid du lhan bzhag pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de rnams ni chos drug ga'u ma dang bcas pa'i 'jug sgo thun mong du byas pa yin la/ gang zag spros pa la dga' bas so sor byed na/ maṇḍal dang po gnyis dang / bzhi pa la brten nas bdag bskyed mdun bskyed/ bum pa chos skyong rnams bskyed pa nas/ bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i dbang bzhi yan chad bskur ba ni/ spyi'i 'jug sgo rgyud sde lnga'i dbang yin/ de nas maṇḍal gsum pa'i bskyed chog bzhin/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bsgom bzlas mchod gtor rnams byas/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i chos rnams gong bzhin rgyun bshags yan chad drug po rgyas par grub na legs/ ci ste ma grub na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tsam byas nas gong gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi gdams ngag dbang dang 'brel ba ni sgyu lus kyi sgos dbang / dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba gong ma'i dmigs pa ni/ ga'u ma'i sgos dbang / dbang gdams ngag dang 'brel ba 'og ma'i stong pas gzhi byas rig pa sna tshogs su 'char ba/ 'od gsal gyi sgos dbang / rtsa lam sbyang rig pa sna tshogs su 'char ba dang / srid pa'i dbang zhu ba thabs lam gyi sgos dbang / rang lus dag pa lha skur bsgom pa rmi lam gyi sgos dbang des bar do'i sgos dbang du'ang 'gro ste/ rmi lam zin na bar do nyams 'og tu tshud pas so/ /'pho ba la rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs gang rung te/ mkha' spyod ma'i thob na legs so/ /gang ltar yang gsum pa rjes la bla ma la yon dbul/ tshogs la rol/ lhag gtor dang / rdo rje'i glu bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam rnams bya/ gtang rag gi mchod pa dbul/ 'dod don la gsol ba btab/

bzod gsol dang gshegs gsol bya/ yi ge gsum gyis bdag bsrung / las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /'chug med lam khyer rnam gsum gyi 'jug sgo dang / 'chi med kyi 'jug sgo zur na yod/ 'di dag ni ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i gsung ngag las/ grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor pas zhib par bkral ba la/ rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis phyag len du mdzad tshod rnams dkyus go bar bris pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgrub pa po dar ma blo gros la sogs gus ldan slob mas gsol ba btab nas/ sgyu lus kyi btsun pa gangs khrod pas yos bu'i lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu drug la grub par dben gnas rdo rje gdan du sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig /'dis sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ //dge'o// ༈ //'dis gtor chog gi skabs su lha lnga'i bstod pa ma grub na/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /mi skyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /bde ba mchog la rnam rol pa'i/ /sgyu ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyed la 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ mdor bsdus pa ni/ rigs lnga'i spyi bstod gang yang rung ba bya'o//
